column2: [4] Burning Bridges

As the seriousness of the Arachnid incursion becomes undeniable, martial law is declared in Mahanagar. A radical decision is made to stem the tide: All bridges leading into the central district must be destroyed.

After this plan fails in Verhaegen’s sector, the Mobile Infantry and MPD have to step in once more to salvage the situation.

column2: Hmm -- I'll save the rooting for later, Major. Bugs on the way!

Seems your lil' "intuition" show has impressed some of my bosses at Intel, Keys. I don't know how you've been missed as a psychic all these years, but it's sure saving me a few scrapes on this op, anyway.
Fed Intelligence are watching, huh? That got you worried that you might one day be saluting me, Major?
More the idea that you or those cranks might be rooting around inside my head. Never have warmed to that...

column2: Ready up! Another attack coming!
The Bugs are coming!
They're all over us! We're done for!
Don't die on me now, Keys! Keys!?
Goddamnit! Our flyboys missed their mark on the bridge out of the district.
Fleet's screw-up gives the Bugs free reign to keep on coming.
Best we can do for now is contain them by raising the drawbridges...
... while our cop buddies keep the highway locked down. We'll find a way to fix this mess after that!
Drawbridge is up. Good work!
One less bridge for the Bugs to use.
That's the Bugs cut off from the drawbridges. Now to kick the rest of 'em back into the Ganda.
Save some for us -- we're packing up and heading to you.
We've pushed across the first bridge, Keys. We'll close up shop behind us to ease the attacks on your end.
Let's keep raising the bridges all along the canal, troopers.
Bug nests burned. Now to raise the remaining drawbridges and keep it that way.
Won't be much use closing the island if we leave Bug Hives lying around. Let's clear them out!
Plasma Bug in the AO! We'll catch hell trying to fight under its bombardment.
Bring up the Cyclones. The M.I.'s newest toy will be able to rush its position with ease!
Ha! Now that's a weapon!
Wavebreaker online!
All Wavebreaker batteries set. Better get runnin', Bugs!
It's about time we turn the tide of this thing. Get a couple Wavebreaker batteries up and really show the Bugs who they're messing with!
Of course... the last bridge has no damn power! It'll need rebooting from the nearby power station.

The sector is secured. Now, time to finish the job our flyboys left behind.
Bring up the techs -- we're blowing this damn bridge to hell ourselves!
Plasma Bugs! We shouldn't be hanging around in their range anyway -- just get the explosives down!
Argh... there it is again... Do Fed Intel ever teach you how to get used to this?
You better not be in my head, Keys!
It's worse than whatever you've got bouncing around in there, Major. Something nasty is lurking in that plant...
Then I s'pose I should introduce myself properly...
Come on out you ugly son of a--!
--whoa! Whatever stink-hole the Bugs dredged you up from, you took half of it with you!
Don’t let those stinkin' Bugs bully us back! Get some turrets down and show 'em proper firepower!
